rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a hatching 4AA blastocyst with strong ICM/TE and zona thinning, but includes some image-specific details like exact quadrant location and extruded degenerating debris that may be over-interpreted from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, AMH, endometrium, first-cycle status, diagnosis, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logical and well-structured, with probability estimates generally consistent with the case, though some quantitative adjustments and claims about hatching benefit are somewhat speculative.

Mostly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, but includes less guideline-supported suggestions such as ERA after a single failed transfer and strong emphasis on SDF/PGT-A in a first-cycle unexplained case.
Provides clear practical recommendations for luteal support, monitoring, lifestyle changes, and future planning, though a few suggestions are more optional than standard-of-care.
